clips.title: The story
paras: A broken barrel on Westfall's western shore holds Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure clue. It sends you north toward an old jug beside a coastal windmill, another step along the late pirate's trail to his hidden riches.

Captain Sanders scattered his directions along Westfall's western shore. Each clue leads only to the next container, never straight to the prize. You have to follow the trail from one barrel, chest, or jug to another across the bluffs to reach his plunder.

From the broken barrel, the parchment points due north toward the sea cliffs. Beside an isolated windmill on the bluffs, an abandoned jug holds the next clue. Murlocs and Defias scavengers roam coastal Westfall, so the way north carries danger.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Searching through the barrel you discover another piece of parchment. This one reads: Now from this here barrel, face ye North. Straight as the crow flies, keep ye walkin' till you see the empty jug next to the lone windmill on the sea bluffs. If ye poke around that jug, ye just might find what you're lookin' for.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're on your way to the jackpot, treasure seeker!
